description: Read and edit Overleaf papers from any AI client. Edits can arrive as tracked-change suggestions.
name: io.github.yangzichao/mcp-server-overleaf

environmentVariables.description: Overleaf Git authentication token, from https://www.overleaf.com/user/settings under Git integration.
environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_GIT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: The project to open: its 24-character id, or the Overleaf address bar URL that contains it.
environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_PROJECT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional. An Overleaf browser session cookie, which turns on the tracked-changes tools: suggest an edit, read the review panel, leave a comment.
environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_SESSION_COOKIE

packageArguments.description: Serve on stdio, which is the transport a local client starts.

title: Overleaf
